question: Pandit Shivnath Mishra, Padma Shri Awardee in 2022, is well known for his contribution to which of the following musical instruments?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Sitar__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandit Shivnath Mishra** is an Indian **sitarist**.
 
• He is an exponent of the **Benares Gharana** school of Indian classical music.
 
• He was formerly a lecturer and the Head of the Music Department at the Sampurnanand Sanskrit University, Varanasi.
 
• Shivnath Mishra was awarded the title of **Padma Shri in 2022**.
 
• He is the only Sitar player from Varanasi to have received the Padma Shri Award after Pandit Ravi Shankar.
 
• Shivnath Mishra was awarded the **UP Sangeet Natak Academy Award in 2004**.
